RN-01.title: On-foot movement and camera feel
RN-01.measure: time from rest to full walk and full run, stop distance, turn rate on the spot and while running, walk and run speeds in m/s, camera follow lag and recentre time, camera distance and height on foot
RN-01.games: KCD2 (third-person cut-scenes excluded; its first person only as contrast), GTA V, RDR2, Mafia: Definitive Edition, Sleeping Dogs, The Last of Us Part II
RN-01.how: the driving method (DRIVING-MEASUREMENT-METHOD-2026-11-19): clips played in Chrome, never downloaded; frame-stepped; five samples a number; two independent measurers; bands set as game band and floor; joins next week's block (advisor 256)
RN-01.status: lane researching the game list tonight (FEEL-REFERENCE-GAMES-2026-11-20, pending)

RN-02.title: Carrying a load
RN-02.measure: speed loss while carrying by load size, whether running is allowed, how the load shows (hands, posture), pick-up and put-down times
RN-02.games: RDR2 (carrying bodies and boxes), GTA V, KCD2, Mafia: Definitive Edition
RN-02.how: as RN-01, one extra row on the shared sheet

RN-03.title: Hiding and keeping out of sight without a stealth mode
RN-03.measure: what reference games let a player do to avoid notice in a town without crouch-walk (standing still, turning away, doorways, crowds); detection time in dark against light; how it is shown without meters
RN-03.games: KCD2 (town stealth, hoods), Hitman (social stealth, as contrast), Mafia: Definitive Edition, Watch Dogs: Legion
RN-03.how: as RN-01; plus published developer talks on KCD2's detection

RN-04.title: Tailing on foot and by car
RN-04.measure: the distance bands at which a target notices, how the warning shows, how long the player may be out of sight before the tail is lost, and how often reference tail missions fail players
RN-04.games: GTA V, Sleeping Dogs, Mafia: Definitive Edition, Watch Dogs: Legion, Assassin's Creed (contrast; tail missions widely criticised)
RN-04.how: as RN-01; player criticism read from reviews and forums for what to avoid

RN-05.title: Melee bands re-measured from footage
RN-05.measure: C1 to C15 from the melee sheet: contact times, hit-stop, reaction lengths, wind-up readability
RN-05.games: KCD2, GTA V and IV, Sleeping Dogs, RDR2, The Last of Us Part II, Yakuza 0, Mafia: The Old Country
RN-05.how: FEEL-TARGETS-MELEE section (e) frame plan, outside only

RN-06.title: Firearm feel for rare guns
RN-06.measure: draw time, aim-in time, recoil recovery, how loud and how far the town reacts
RN-06.games: RDR2, Mafia: Definitive Edition, The Last of Us Part II, GTA V
RN-06.how: as RN-01; low priority (guns rare and late)

RN-07.title: Being seen: how reference games show who sees you
RN-07.measure: time from a watcher's first cue to full detection, distances of first notice by light, how the cue is shown (heads, sound, picture), how often players read it right
RN-07.games: KCD2, Hitman 3, Mafia: Definitive Edition, Watch Dogs: Legion, Thief (2014) as contrast
RN-07.how: as RN-01; plus real-world face recognition distance studies for the 8 m and 25 m first values
RN-07.status: planned (advisor 256: being seen measured like driving)

RN-08.title: Chases on foot and by car
RN-08.measure: pursuer speed against the player's, how sight is broken, time to lose a pursuer, chase length in seconds, catch rules
RN-08.games: GTA V, Sleeping Dogs, Mafia: Definitive Edition, Mirror's Edge (contrast), The Getaway

RN-09.title: Searching rooms
RN-09.measure: time per container searched, noise made, how much is found, how players rate it
RN-09.games: KCD2, RDR2, Thief (2014), Deus Ex: Mankind Divided

RN-10.title: Watching and waiting share
RN-10.measure: share of an hour spent waiting or watching in reference open-world games

RN-11.title: The crowd: 1990 hours and variety
RN-11.measure: people on a British port high street by hour in 1990 (period counts, photographs); repeat distance in reference crowds
RN-11.games: period sources first; GTA V, Watch Dogs: Legion, Mafia: Definitive Edition for repeat distance
RN-11.how: period research (library, photographs) plus footage counts

RN-12.title: Crowd avoidance
RN-12.measure: distance at which walkers step aside, bump rate, queue behaviour
RN-12.games: GTA V, RDR2, Watch Dogs: Legion

RN-13.title: 1990 money, rent and custody figures
RN-13.measure: rent for a cab office and flat in a port town in 1990; fence rates; custody hours and bail after a killing in 1990 England
RN-13.how: period sources with dates, links and the date read

RN-14.title: Activity shares (the hour budget)
RN-14.measure: timed one-hour stretches of reference games booked by activity: on foot, driving, talk, jobs, fights and chases, menus and maps, waiting
RN-14.games: GTA V, RDR2, KCD2, Mafia: Definitive Edition, Sleeping Dogs
RN-14.how: his question 20:29 (advisor 257): joins next week's measuring on his PC, hours priced by the lane

RN-15.title: Animals on a 1990 port street
RN-15.measure: which animals and how many, from dated photographs

RN-16.title: Music and silence
RN-16.measure: how much of an hour reference games play music, and where (radios, places, scenes); what players praise
RN-16.games: KCD2, RDR2, Mafia: Definitive Edition, GTA V (radio as contrast), Sleeping Dogs
RN-16.how: as RN-01, a column on the activity sheet

RN-17.title: Streaming hitches
RN-17.measure: acceptable hitch length and count while driving through a town; load screen lengths
RN-17.games: published technical analyses (Digital Foundry) of GTA V, KCD2, Mafia: Definitive Edition
RN-17.how: published analysis read in full, dated

RN-18.title: Collision and ragdoll blending
RN-18.measure: how reference games blend authored falls with physics; what players punish
RN-18.games: GTA IV and V (Euphoria), RDR2, Sleeping Dogs
RN-18.how: developer talks and published analysis; footage as RN-01
